title: One connected workspace
changes: A consistent workflow sidebar connects your library, print preparation, printer tools and support. On mobile, use the bottom navigation and Menu to reach every workspace.
Shorter filament cards, quieter buttons and a compact Filters menu put more of your stock on screen. Your light or dark theme follows you between pages.
Matching reveals phone and export actions after a model is loaded. Printer setup comes first when no bridge is configured, and the setup checklist opens one step at a time.
Labels and QR codes keep their physical print sizes; inventory, import approvals and printer safety checks are unchanged.

title: Labels your way
changes: Choose crisp Classic or Soft corners QR styling. Codes grow on larger labels while keeping a clear white border; always test one printed code before a batch.
Show shelf positions, saved reel locations, your own batch location or no location. Hide optional brand, material and weight details for a cleaner label.
QR printing now asks you to assign missing permanent spool IDs rather than silently leaving codes off. Text-only labels remain available.

title: Bigger, more readable labels
changes: Label text now grows to fit the selected label, with the same sizing in preview and print. Larger paper no longer uses tiny fixed-size text. Added a 105 × 145 mm preset and clearer matching printer-paper, margin and header settings.

title: Printer support for older imports
changes: Older library entries with explicit Basic, Standard, Matte or Silk product names can use Send to printer without re-entering their finish. Saved finish choices stay unchanged; ambiguous product names still require review.

title: Send filament to your U1, without a tag
changes: Send to printer lets you choose a library filament and tool 1–4, review the change and verify printer read-back. Works from iPhone, Android and desktop through a separately configured local bridge.

Optional assignment of an already-mapped physical reel to Spoolman, with material/colour and duplicate-tool checks. Colour-only sends explicitly clear old tracking assignments. Busy printers, expired reviews and unsupported metadata fail closed; printer commands are never retried automatically. No temperatures, heating, motion or print jobs are sent.

title: A calmer way to import
changes: Review detected filament in a compact table, with quantities, costs, similar stock and repeated entries visible at a glance. Open one row for corrections and matching purchase details; select new entries across the batch or deselect everything.

Gmail’s Review selected orders now reads the chosen messages straight into the review table, without a copy-text step. Email results are compact and scroll within their own list. Source text remains available, and nothing is saved without your review. CSV, photo and costs-only imports use the same table.

title: A little nudge for new updates
changes: The What’s New icon now highlights unread releases. Viewing the latest notes clears the highlight across tabs on this browser; a later release lights it up again, without refreshing your work.

title: Your library, in living colour
changes: Explore your available filament in an animated Colour wheel. Slice sizes represent roll counts, neutrals have their own inner ring, and selecting a shade reveals its filament and colour source. Includes pause, keyboard navigation and reduced-motion support.
Gmail now reads HTML-only order emails as plain text on your device, without displaying email markup or loading tracking images. Plain-text versions are preferred and attachments stay excluded.

title: Clearer Gmail order selection
changes: Gmail shows how many emails are selected, stops at ten and offers Clear selection without clearing your draft. Order searches also exclude return, refund and cancellation subjects.

title: Safer Gmail connection setup
changes: Cancelled or outdated Gmail setup can no longer reappear after switching accounts or leaving the page. Connections are prepared for the current account, and disconnect clears that preparation.

title: Shared barcode lookup protection
changes: External barcode lookups now share a persistent allowance across server instances. Busy or exhausted lookups explain when to retry; manual entry and your own saved barcode matches remain available.

title: Enrich costs, keep your place
changes: Update existing costs only: review imported prices against their original purchases without adding stock or changing roll counts, permanent IDs or used marks. Existing prices require explicit replacement confirmation.
Setup stays with you: feature pages show a return-to-checklist bar that brings you back to the same step.

title: Welcome to your workshop
changes: An optional welcome checklist guides you from your first spool to print matching, mobile setup, labels, NFC and Spoolman. Progress follows your account, and you can skip steps or hide the reminder without changing stock or connections.

title: Manufacturer colour matching
changes: Automatic manufacturer hex codes for 69 Bambu PLA Basic, PLA Matte and PETG HF shades. Existing known estimates refresh without discarding saved colours; custom overrides stay protected. Add and import forms fill verified colours and show their source.

title: Our filament community
changes: App & device now shows the combined available-roll count across Spool Studio accounts. Refills count; used-up rolls and unknown quantities do not. Only the total is shared, never individual libraries.

title: Spool prices and filament cost estimates
changes: Optional budgeting fallback: assume £15/kg (editable) where purchase costs are missing. Assumptions are labelled and never saved as actual purchase prices.
Save optional per-roll costs and currency in your library. Import costs from CSV or clearly labelled email/image text, then review before saving.
Match a print now estimates filament costs from manually entered slicer grams, with price ranges and clear unknown-cost warnings. It does not slice your model or extract usage automatically.

title: Easier organising, clearer imports
changes: Gmail test importer: focus on order confirmations and receipts, rather than delivery updates and setup emails. Switch to All matching emails when needed. Gmail is still a private test, not available to every account.
Sort your collection by purchase or import date. Select entries for bulk edits and print labels for just that selection.
Use smaller cards on mobile, with your preference remembered on that device. Full-size cards now keep their action buttons aligned.
Print box and spool labels in multiple sizes, including 60 × 30 mm and MUNBYN 76 × 50 mm. Permanent spool IDs and private QR links are available under Physical spools & usage.
Find this version number and release notes in the library, importer, phone programmer and App & device. Existing installs update online; no reinstall is needed.
